laws.rule: Since 13 January 2026 Miyagi Prefecture charges an accommodation tax of JPY 300 a person a night (about A$2.71, RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82) at hotels, ryokan, simple lodgings and minpaku. No tax under a room-only rate of JPY 6,000 (about A$54.14). In Sendai the JPY 300 is split JPY 100 prefecture and JPY 200 city.

laws.rule: Miyagi Youth Healthy Development Ordinance (宮城県青少年健全育成条例), art. 36. The ordinance sets the late-night period as 11 pm to 4 am. A guardian must try not to let a young person (generally under 18) go out in that period without special reason; the guardian's own duty has no penalty. Anyone else is barred from taking such a young person out, going about with them or keeping them out in that period without the guardian's consent or another proper reason. The offence for others carries a fine of up to JPY 100,000 (about A$902) or a petty fine (kayo). Rates: RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82.
